description: Move tokens from your wallet into the agent vault, and optionally send the agent a little SOL for its own transaction fees. The vault stays owned by you; funding it does not raise the delegated allowance, so the agent still cannot spend past its ceiling. Requires confirm:true to broadcast.

amount.description: Tokens to move into the vault, in whole units (e.g. "50").

secret.description: Owner secret key for this call only.

sol.description: SOL to send the agent for transaction fees (e.g. "0.02").

name: fund_agent_wallet
title: Top up an agent's vault, and its fee SOL
